name: HA3OUD
source:
A visual novel about gays in the revolution in a semi-fictional Arab country. Plot a revolution with your brother and his friends--seek out justice... and maybe love??

[Edited from [url=https://toreachpoise.itch.io/ha3oud]itch.io[/url]]
